requirements.summary: Deploy the current draft Version 7 to the production environment to make the app publicly accessible
acceptanceCriteria: Version 7 is successfully deployed to production
All button clicks and data loading functions work correctly in the live production environment
The production deployment matches the working draft version

file_operations.description: Verify all route configurations are production-ready and remove any draft-specific debugging code or console logs that should not appear in production
Review and ensure all comment generation functionality, device-based restrictions, and list selection features work correctly; remove any temporary debugging statements
Verify username checking, localStorage persistence, and export functionality are production-ready; ensure no draft-only features remain
Confirm image upload with progress tracking works correctly; verify ExternalBlob usage follows component guidelines and remove any development-only code
Ensure all admin tabs (comments, images, chat, live lists, settings) are fully functional and properly secured with authorization checks
Verify navigation links work correctly across all routes and admin access is properly gated
Ensure actor initialization and admin access token handling are production-ready; verify proper error handling for backend connection failures
Confirm Internet Identity authentication flow works correctly in production environment; ensure proper cleanup on logout
Verify all comment management hooks (create, update, delete, bulk operations) handle errors gracefully and display appropriate user feedback
Ensure single and bulk comment generation hooks work correctly with proper error handling and loading states
Verify live list checking functionality and app/username management work correctly in production
Confirm image upload, listing, and deletion hooks work correctly; verify ExternalBlob component usage follows guidelines
Ensure chat message fetching and sending work correctly with proper error handling
Verify bulk generator key management hooks work securely in production
Ensure layout renders correctly with background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/dreamy-bg.dim_1920x1080.png), navigation, and footer; verify responsive behavior
Verify authorization wrapper properly shows loading states and access denied messages; ensure admin-only content is properly protected
Confirm device ID generation and single-use tracking work correctly across browser sessions
Verify URL parameter utilities work correctly with sessionStorage in production environment
Review global styles, theme variables, and dark mode setup; ensure production-ready styling with no draft-specific overrides
Verify Tailwind configuration is optimized for production build with proper purging of unused styles
Ensure React Query and Internet Identity provider setup is production-ready with appropriate error boundaries and retry logic
